name: Elder Varen
description: An ancient keeper of forgotten bloodline secrets who knows more about the missing scholar than he admits.

name: Lyra Vey
description: A researcher investigating the Bloodlands' oldest bloodline records before disappearing beneath the watchtower.

name: Warden Marek
description: A hardened forest warden who has been tracking creatures drawn toward the scholar's research.

name: Kora Ironhand
description: A master smith who crafts legendary weapons and knows the history of Blackspire Keep.

name: Keeper Serah
description: The last known guardian of the Bloodglass Sanctum and its sealed bloodline records.
